Inspect visually and compile a preliminary list of observed structural issues.
3. Use appropriate tools and instruments for a detailed assessment.

6. Include photographs and drawings for clarity.
7. Discuss any immediate safety concerns and recommend corrective actions.
8. Prepare a summary that highlights critical findings and necessary repairs.
